cohort: The study included 15 healthy term-born infants with a median gestational age of 39.6 weeks and a median birth weight of 3560g.
finding: Spontaneous breathing was associated with collapse of the IVC and increased antegrade DV and HV flow velocity during inspiration, suggesting that inspiration could be a factor driving placental transfusion in infants.
cross-section timing: Directly after birth, until the umbilical cord was clamped
